summary: Per-frame AI pit-stop logic on the F1CVehicle: schedules tire-compound selection relative to lap count and session state, re-arms wing-repair lap records, and on a blocking condition retires the vehicle (sets RetiredFlag, clears AIControlFlag, logs via sub_4BC060) and cleans up the pit-stop state.

operations.description: Set pit-lane flag at +0x4548 to 1 and clear byte at +0x4584 to 0 on entry.

Compute tire-change timing value v4: if lap counter at +0x45E0 plus 1 exceeds lap count at +0x4588, branch on session dword_7C56A4 == 7 (use dword_8ACF8C - lapNumber + 1.5, and set +0x4584 to 1 when dword_7C56A8 != 8; otherwise use per-lap record) or use per-lap record; else add 1.5 to record difference against lapNumber at +0x403C. Store to local v17.

If rear-wing pit data flag at obj+0xD18 is set, obj+0xD58 is clear and dword_7C56A4 == 7: call ConditionalGate, clear +0x4584, write lapNumber to the current-lap tire record slot and set the tire-choice index to 8.

If byte at +0x39FA is set and dword_7C56A4 == 7: call ConditionalGate, clear +0x4584, write lapNumber to the current-lap tire record slot and set the tire-choice index to 8 (same re-arm path as the rear-wing condition).

If PitStopBlockingCondition(this) or dword_7C56A4 != 7: set local result v16 to 0, call SceneRenderUpdate(0), set time-of-next-exit at +0x4534 to dbl_8AFEA0 + 180.0, and when dword_7C56A4 == 7 additionally set RetiredFlag at +0x4410 to 1, clear AIControlFlag at +0x45F4 to 0 and call sub_4BC060(1) to log the retirement.
Clamp v17 to a 3.0 minimum, multiply by compound scale at +0x45E8, cap at the field +0x3988, store into the current-lap tire-compound slot and call ClampedIndexAssignment with the result.
When v16 is clear (blocking path taken): call SpeedValueSetterWithGlobalMirror with the compound value and PostPitCleanup(this).
If front-wing record (obj+0xCD4 set while obj+0xD14 clear) or rear-wing record (obj+0xD18 set while obj+0xD58 clear) indicates a damaged wing: call StateTransition(1).
Select compound tier index v18 from flt_8AFEE8 thresholds (>=0.66 -> 6, >=0.33 -> 5, >=0.01 -> 4), falling back to the stored next-chosen-tires value at +0x458C below 0.01.
Scan up to 7 entries starting at this+0x4600; when an entry matches the selected tier index, decrement the index at +0x3378 (via IndexDecrementWithBoundsWrap or UtilityFunction_5750) at most 8 times.
Return v16 as the byte service-ready result.

clean_pseudocode: if (PitStopBlockingCondition(this) || sessionTier!=7) { sceneUpdate(); vehicle->timeOfNextExit(0x4534) = dbl_8AFEA0 + 180.0; if (sessionTier==7) { vehicle->RetiredFlag(0x4410)=1; vehicle->AIControlFlag(0x45F4)=0; sub_4BC060(1); } }
clamped = ClampedIndexAssignment(max(timing,3.0) * scale(0x45E8), cap 0x3988); store to current-lap compound slot;
for each of 7 entries at 0x4600: if (entry == tier) adjustIndex(0x3378) up to 8 times;
